about.title: FPFK
about.subtitle: A community of believers growing in faith together since 2005.
about.story: FPFK Church was founded with a simple mission: to love God and love people. What started as a small gathering has grown into a vibrant community that spans generations.
about.beliefs: We believe the Bible is the inspired Word of God. We believe in the power of prayer, the importance of community, and the call to serve others as Jesus did.
